title: Performance optimization: bundle, image optimization, DB query tuning
acceptance_criteria: Next.js bundle analysis run, large dependencies identified and optimized
Dynamic imports with next/dynamic for heavy components (analysis results, upload dialogs)
Image optimization: next/image configured with DO Spaces remotePatterns
Database queries analyzed with EXPLAIN ANALYZE, missing indexes created
RLS policy performance verified (no seq scans on tenant_id)
Lighthouse performance score ≥ 90 on desktop and mobile
API response times under 200ms for cached analyses, under 2s for uncached
Bundle size report generated and checked into docs/
